Dear Colleague,
Your indicative funding allocation for the @year1 to @year2 academic year
Please find below your indicative funding allocation statement for your general annual grant funding for the @year1 to @year2 academic year.

We will confirm your allocation towards the end of the month in which you open. Please note that changes between an indicative and confirmed funding allocation happen rarely and in exceptional circumstances only.
Your funding will be paid in equal instalments on the first working day of each month, except in the first month of opening where payment will be made on the sixth working day of the month.
What you need to do next
<ul style='line-height:160%;'>
• return your completed academy bank details form no later than the twentieth of the month prior to your intended opening date, if you have not already done so
• check the account has been activated by your bank
• set up your own business systems
• create your document exchange account
• make sure your contact details on Get Information about Schools are accurate and complete
• register for DfE update alerts
Understanding your indicative allocation statement
There is a range of information available to help you understand your allocation statement.
<ul style='list-style-type:square;line-height:160%;'>
• Academy general annual grant allocation guide: @year2 to @year3 academic year
• Academies planning calendar
• Academy trust handbook
Contact us
We hope this material provides all the information you need but please contact us via the customer help portal
if you have any further questions about your allocation.
I would like to take this opportunity to wish you every success for the future.
Yours faithfully,
Andy Humphreys
Provider Data Team Leader, Funding and Financial Oversight Directorate,
Department for Education
